situations.title: 중환자 혈당 목표 이해
situations.tagline: The last hospital kept my sugar really tight — why are you letting it run higher here?
situations.brief: 중환자 혈당 목표 140-180 범위의 근거를 이해하고 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: In the ICU we aim for a sugar between 140 and 180 for your safety.
Keeping it too tight here can cause dangerous lows.
This target lowers your risk while you're critically ill.
goals: 중환자 혈당 목표 범위의 근거를 이해한다

situations.title: POC 혈당 측정·기록
situations.tagline: You just checked my sugar an hour ago — why do you need to do it again already?
situations.brief: POC 혈당을 정확하게 측정하고 주기에 맞춰 기록하세요.
keyPhrases: We check frequently so we can adjust your insulin safely.
I'll warm your finger and use a fresh drop for an accurate reading.
I'm recording each result so the team sees your trend.

situations.title: 인슐린 주입 프로토콜 이해
situations.tagline: Can you explain how this insulin drip decides how much I get each hour?
situations.brief: nomogram 기반 인슐린 주입 프로토콜의 원리를 이해하고 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: The drip follows a chart that sets the rate from your sugar level.
As your sugar changes, the protocol tells us how to adjust it.
This keeps your insulin dose safe and consistent.
goals: nomogram 기반 주입 프로토콜의 원리를 이해한다

situations.title: 저혈당 징후 인지
situations.tagline: I'm feeling shaky and sweaty all of a sudden — is my sugar dropping?
situations.brief: 자율신경과 신경당결핍 증상을 통해 저혈당 징후를 인지하세요.
keyPhrases: Those shaky, sweaty feelings can mean a low sugar, so let's check now.
Tell me right away if you feel confused or lightheaded.
I'll treat it quickly if your sugar is low.
goals: 저혈당 의심 시 즉시 혈당을 확인한다

situations.title: 영양 연계 혈당 관리
situations.tagline: They just started my tube feeding — is that why my sugar keeps changing?
situations.brief: TPN과 장관 공급 변화에 맞춰 혈당을 연계 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: Your feeding adds sugar, so we adjust your insulin along with it.
When your nutrition changes, your sugar can change too.
I'll match your insulin to your feeding to keep it steady.
goals: TPN과 장관 공급 변화가 혈당에 미치는 영향을 이해한다
영양 변화에 맞춰 혈당을 연계 관리한다

situations.title: 혈당 경향 보고
situations.tagline: His sugars have been creeping up over the last few hours — should we flag it?
situations.brief: 혈당의 추세를 파악하고 팀에 명확히 소통하세요.
keyPhrases: His sugars are trending up, so I'll update the provider.
Let's look at the pattern over the last several checks together.
I'll report the trend, not just the single value.

situations.title: 인슐린 주입 적정 titration
situations.tagline: His numbers keep bouncing — how are you deciding to change the drip rate?
situations.brief: 프로토콜에 따라 인슐린 주입 속도를 적정하게 조정하세요.
keyPhrases: I adjust the rate based on his current sugar and how fast it's changing.
The protocol tells me how much to increase or decrease.
I'll recheck in an hour and titrate again as needed.
goals: 혈당과 변화 속도를 근거로 주입을 적정한다

situations.title: 스테로이드 유발 고혈당 관리
situations.tagline: Ever since they started the steroids, my sugar's been sky high — what now?
situations.brief: 스테로이드 유발 고혈당을 인지하고 인슐린을 조정하세요.
keyPhrases: Steroids can raise your sugar, so we increase your insulin to match.
Your sugar often peaks in the afternoon with steroids.
As the steroid dose changes, we'll adjust your insulin too.

situations.title: 저혈당 예방·교정 프로토콜
situations.tagline: My sugar dropped low again — how are you going to bring it back up?
situations.brief: 15/15 규칙을 적용해 저혈당을 예방하고 교정하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm treating your low with fast sugar and rechecking in fifteen minutes.
If it's still low, we'll treat again until you're safe.
Then we'll look at why it dropped to prevent the next one.

situations.title: 장관영양 중단 시 인슐린 조정
situations.tagline: They stopped my feeding for a test — won't the insulin drop my sugar too low now?
situations.brief: 장관영양 중단 등 급식 변동 시 인슐린을 안전하게 조정하세요.
keyPhrases: When your feeding stops, we adjust your insulin so you don't go low.
I may start some dextrose to keep your sugar steady.
I'll check your sugar more often while feeding is paused.
goals: 급식 중단 시 저혈당 위험을 인지한다

situations.title: 주입에서 피하 전환 관리
situations.tagline: Are you finally taking me off this IV drip and switching to shots?
situations.brief: 주입에서 피하 인슐린으로 안전하게 전환하며 overlap을 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: We give your first long-acting shot before stopping the drip.
That overlap keeps your sugar covered during the switch.
I'll watch your sugar closely for a few hours after.
goals: 주입 종료 전 피하 인슐린 overlap을 확보한다

situations.title: 신부전 환자 인슐린 조정
situations.tagline: My kidneys aren't working right — does that change how much insulin I need?
situations.brief: 신부전 환자의 인슐린 청소 저하를 고려해 용량을 조정하세요.
keyPhrases: Your kidneys clear insulin slower, so it can last longer in your body.
We often need less insulin to avoid lows.
I'll monitor your sugar carefully and adjust gently.
goals: 청소 저하를 고려해 인슐린 용량을 조정한다

situations.title: 혈당 변동성 관리
situations.tagline: My sugar keeps swinging high then low — how do we make it stop bouncing?
situations.brief: 혈당의 급변을 완화하도록 변동성을 안정적으로 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: We look for what's driving the swings, like feeding or timing.
Smoother insulin adjustments help level out the ups and downs.
I'll check your sugar more often until it's more stable.

situations.title: 패혈증 중 혈당 불안정 관리
situations.tagline: His sugars are all over the place since the sepsis started — is that expected?
situations.brief: 패혈증의 스트레스 고혈당으로 인한 혈당 불안정을 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: Sepsis causes stress hyperglycemia, so his sugars can be unstable.
We check more often and titrate the drip closely.
As his infection improves, the sugars should settle.

situations.title: POC와 정맥혈당 불일치 인지
situations.tagline: The finger stick and the lab draw came back really different — which one do we trust?
situations.brief: POC와 정맥혈당의 불일치를 인지하고 측정 한계를 고려하세요.
keyPhrases: Point-of-care readings can differ from a lab draw in certain conditions.
If they conflict, we confirm with a venous sample.
Poor perfusion or anemia can skew the finger stick.

situations.title: 심한 저혈당 의식저하 위기
situations.tagline: He's suddenly unresponsive and clammy — his sugar has to be dangerously low!
situations.brief: 심한 저혈당 의식저하에 응급 D50와 소생 대응을 시행하세요.
keyPhrases: Stop the insulin and push D50 now — check a stat glucose.
I'm protecting his airway while we treat the low.
Recheck in five minutes and repeat if he's still low.
goals: 인슐린 중단과 응급 포도당으로 소생 대응한다

situations.title: 인슐린 용량사고 위기
situations.tagline: Wait — I think the wrong insulin dose may have gone in, we need to act fast.
situations.brief: 인슐린 용량사고를 이중확인으로 인지하고 즉시 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's stop the drip and verify exactly what was given.
Check his sugar now and start dextrose if he's dropping.
I'll notify the provider and document the event.
goals: 혈당 확인과 포도당으로 즉시 대응하고 보고한다

situations.title: 고혈당 위기 DKA 진행 인지
situations.tagline: My sugar's been high for hours and now I feel nauseous and out of breath — what's wrong?
situations.brief: 지속 고혈당에서 산증 에스컬레이션과 DKA 진행을 인지하세요.
keyPhrases: Your symptoms could mean acid is building up, so we're checking now.
I'm drawing labs for ketones and blood acid right away.
We'll escalate your treatment quickly if it's progressing to DKA.

situations.title: 급식 중단 후 저혈당 급변
situations.tagline: The feeding pump stopped but the insulin's still running — his sugar's crashing!
situations.brief: 급식 중단 후 인슐린 미조정으로 인한 저혈당 급변에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: The feeding stopped so we must stop or cut the insulin now.
Start dextrose and recheck his sugar immediately.
Let's set an alert so this doesn't happen again.
goals: 급식 중단과 인슐린 지속의 위험을 즉시 인지한다

situations.title: 반복 저혈당 프로토콜 재설계
situations.tagline: This is the third low today — can we please rethink his whole insulin plan?
situations.brief: 반복 저혈당의 원인을 재평가하고 프로토콜을 안전하게 재설계하세요.
keyPhrases: Three lows means we need to review the whole regimen with the team.
Let's look at feeding, renal function, and dosing together.
I'll propose a safer protocol to prevent the next low.

situations.title: 혈당 급변·의식변화 감별
situations.tagline: He got confused all of a sudden — is it his sugar or something else entirely?
situations.brief: 혈당 급변과 의식변화의 원인을 감별하고 적절히 에스컬레이션하세요.
keyPhrases: First I'll check his sugar, since a low or high can cause confusion.
If the sugar is normal, we look for other causes right away.
Either way, I'm escalating this change to the team.
